instruction.text: Look at the timeline of kings after Athelstan. Find King Aethelred.
instruction.sound: Look at the timeline of kings after Athelstan. Find King Ethelred.

end.text: After King Athelstan died, the next rulers tried to keep the peace. However, when Aethelred became King in AD 978, things started to change ...
end.sound: After King Athelstan died, the next rulers tried to keep the peace. However, when Ethelred became King in AD 978, things started to change ...

end.text: After Aethelred became king, the Vikings started to attack again. He dealt with the Vikings so poorly that he was given the nickname Aethelred the Unready!
end.sound: After Ethelred became king, the Vikings started to attack again. He dealt with the Vikings so poorly that he was given the nickname Ethelred the Unready.

atoms.b: In AD 980, only two years after ((++Aethelred Edgar)) became King, the Vikings started attacking England again in small groups.
atoms.sound: In AD 980, only two years after Ethelred became King, the Vikings started attacking England again in small groups.

atoms.b: It was obvious that Aethelred was not ((++powerful pretty)) or organised enough to stop the Vikings from raiding. Eventually, after losing a ((++battle bottle)) in AD 991, Aethelred decided to find another way to stop the Vikings.
atoms.sound: It was obvious that Ethelred was not powerful or organised enough to stop the Vikings from raiding. Eventually, after losing a battle in AD 991, Ethelred decided to find another way to stop the Vikings.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

end.text: As fighting wasn’t working, Aethelred tried to defend England from the Vikings by paying them instead. This was known as Danegeld.
end.sound: As fighting wasn’t working, Ethelred tried to defend England from the Vikings by paying them instead. This was known as Dane-geld.

atoms.a: What do you think Aethelred did to stop the Vikings?
atoms.sound: What do you think Ethelred did to stop the Vikings?

instruction.text: Read the scales. How much silver did King Aethelred pay the Vikings?
instruction.sound: Read the scales. How much silver did King Ethelred pay the Vikings?

end.text: Although Aethelred was not the first king to pay Danegeld, the amount that he paid was huge! He used taxes from ordinary people to fund this, which made lots of people very angry.
end.sound: Although Ethelred was not the first king to pay Dane-geld, the amount that he paid was huge! He used taxes from ordinary people to fund this, which made lots of people very angry.

atoms.a: How much do you think this would be worth today?
